e715_dictionary_vs_sae.question: at a position of GPT-2 small, do k atoms chosen from native rows plus collective fields account for the state's effect on the output better than k native rows alone, k SAE latents alone, or rows plus SAE directions, scored by the downstream KL of replacing the state?
P1: at k = 16, rows plus fields recover more of the mean-ablation KL than the SAE encoder's top sixteen latents
P2: at k = 16, rows plus fields recover 0.05 more than rows alone
P3: the SAE's full active set (all of its active latents, about sixty) recovers more than sixty-four atoms of rows plus fields
P4: sixteen SAE decoder directions chosen by pursuit recover more than the encoder's own top sixteen latents
P5: sixteen atoms from rows plus SAE directions beat the better of rows alone and SAE directions alone by 0.03
P6: rows plus fields match the SAE's top sixteen on intervention fidelity (the rank agreement of the effects of eight fixed perturbations on the true state and on the reconstruction)
P7: sixteen native rows beat the stream's top sixteen principal directions
P8: the SAE encoder's top sixteen latents beat sixteen native rows
runs: gpt2 blocks 5 and 8 (jbloom resid_pre SAEs at blocks 6 and 9); 256 positions, 128 scored by KL, k 16, 32, 64

e716_brake_robustness.question: do the brake's numbers depend on the sixteen and the five percent: the off-class share of the k-input damage, the excitatory-only runaway and the signed repair, for k of 8, 16 and 32 and class cuts of 1, 5 and 20 percent?
R1: the off-class share of the sixteen-input damage is at least 0.5 at every class cut (1, 5 and 20 percent)
R2: k excitatory wires alone cost more than three times the ablation damage over all positions for k of 8, 16 and 32
R3: k excitatory plus k inhibitory wires cost less at the firings than the k largest by magnitude, for every k
R4: the off-class share falls as the class cut widens from 1 to 20 percent
R5: thirty-two wires leave at least 0.5 of the ablation damage at the firings (the crowd is not thirty-two wires either)
runs: pythia410 b12 and qwen05 b12, 40 neurons, 64 windows
